sources.title: Prannesshkva/QU-SSM-15M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: QU-SSM-15M is a standalone, from-scratch State Space Model architecture that eliminates contractive Hurwitz dissipation in linear recurrent models by parameterizing transitions in the Lie Group SO (N) via the Cayley transform while enabling selective noise filtering via dynamic forget gating. Author: Prannessh K.V.A. (prannesshkva@gmail.com)
